## Differentially Expressed Genes
```{r}
cts0 <- AverageExpression(
    seurat,
    group.by = "ident",
    # group.by = c(snn_cluster, "Type"),
    assay = assay,
    layer = "data",
    return.seurat = FALSE
) %>% 
  pluck(assay) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "^g")) %>%
  mutate(gene = rownames(.))

cts <- calc_other_cluster_avg(cts0)

# ids <- data.frame(
#     id.1 = c(6, 3, 3, 3, 0, 0, 4, 5, 5),
#     id.2 = c(2, 2, 6, 0, 1, 4, 1, 1, 4)
# )

cluster_marker_genes0 <- list.map(
  levels(Idents(seurat)),
  # seq(nrow(ids)),
  f(x) ~ FindConservedMarkers(
    ident.1 = x,
    # ident.1 = ids[x, 1],
    # ident.2 = ids[x, 2],
    grouping.var = "Patient",
    assay = assay,
    # grouping.var = "Type",
    seurat,
    logfc.threshold = .Machine$double.xmin
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      cluster = x,
      # cluster = paste(ids[x, 2], ids[x, 1], sep = " vs "),
      gene = rownames(.),
      log2FoldChange = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("avg_log2FC")), na.rm = TRUE),
      padj = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("p_val_adj")), na.rm = TRUE),
      `pct.1` = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("pct.1")), na.rm = TRUE),
      `pct.2` = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("pct.2")), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
  # left_join(select(cts, all_of(c("gene", ids[x, 1], ids[x, 2]))) %>% set_colnames(c("gene", "exp.1", "exp.2")), by = "gene")
  left_join(select(cts, all_of(c("gene", x, paste0("except_", x)))) %>% set_colnames(c("gene", "exp.1", "exp.2")), by = "gene")
)
cluster_marker_genes <- list.rbind(cluster_marker_genes0)

min_p <- cluster_marker_genes %>%
  filter(padj > 0) %>%
  summarise(min_padj = min(padj)) %>%
  pull(min_padj)

cluster_marker_genes$padj[which(cluster_marker_genes$padj == 0)] <- min_p
```

```{r}
fc_threshold  <- log2(1.5)
p_threshold <- .05
pct_threshold <- 0.25
exp_threshold <- 0.1

l_dea_raw <- cluster_marker_genes %>%
  mutate(gene_name = gene) %>%
  format_dea(fc_threshold = fc_threshold, p_threshold = p_threshold)
```

## Volcano plots
```{r}
l_dea_proc <- l_dea_raw %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(cluster)))))) %>%
    group_split(cluster, .keep = TRUE) %>%
    set_names(map_chr(., ~as.character(first(.x$cluster)))) %>%
    list.map(
        select(., -cluster) %>%
            mutate(
              Expression = ifelse(
                pct.1 > pct_threshold | exp.1 > exp_threshold,
                Expression, 
                "ns"
                )
              )
    )

list.map(
    l_dea_proc, f(x, xx, xxx) ~
        fct_count(x$Expression) %>%
        filter(f!="ns") %>%
        set_colnames(c("Nb DEG", xxx))) %>%
    Reduce(function(x, y) left_join(x, y, by = "Nb DEG"), .) %>%
    bind_rows(summarise(., `Nb DEG` = "Total", across(-`Nb DEG`, sum, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    kable0()

l_deg_top <- list.map(
  l_dea_proc,
  f(x) ~ top_genes(
    x,
    fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
    p_threshold = p_threshold,
    n = 15
  )
)

p <- list.map(
    discard(l_dea_proc, function(x) nrow(x) == 0),
    f(x, y, z) ~ {
        volcano_plot(
            x,
            title = z,
            top_genes = l_deg_top[[y]],
            fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
            cex = 1,
            cex_genes = 3.5,
            p_threshold = p_threshold,
            max.overlaps = 1e3,
            force = 1e2
        ) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = z) +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
    })

plot_grid(plotlist = p, align = "hv", ncol = 4, nrow = 2)
```
```{r}
list.map(
    l_dea_proc, f(x, xx, xxx) ~
        fct_count(x$Expression) %>%
        filter(f!="ns") %>%
        set_colnames(c("Nb DEG", xxx))) %>%
    Reduce(function(x, y) left_join(x, y, by = "Nb DEG"), .) %>%
    bind_rows(summarise(., `Nb DEG` = "Total", across(-`Nb DEG`, sum, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    kable0()
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
gene_lists <- list.map(l_deg_top, pull(., "gene_name") %>% sort())
custom_upset_barplot(gene_lists, ratio = 1)
```

## Enrichment
```{r, eval = FALSE}
if (species == "human") {
  org_lib <- "org.Hs.eg.db"
} else {
    org_lib <- "org.Mm.eg.db"
}
library(org_lib, character.only = TRUE)
filter <- dplyr::filter
select <- dplyr::select
rename <- dplyr::rename
```

### ORA
```{r, eval = FALSE}
l_ora <- list.map(
  l_dea,
  f(x) ~enrichGO(
    gene = pull(x, "gene_name"),
    OrgDb = get(org_lib),
    keyType = "ALIAS",
    ont = "ALL",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    universe = Features(seurat)
  )
)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
list.map(
    l_ora ,
    f(x, y, z) ~ {
      plot_enrich(
        x,
        cex = 0.65,
        label_x = "generatio",
        method = "ora",
        # regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
        n = 15,
        title = z,
        name_id = "GeneRatio"
      )
    }
) %>% 
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

list.map(l_ora, f(i) ~print_enrich(i, method = method) %>% nrow()) %>%
    list.cbind() %>%
    set_rownames("# Pathway GO") %>%
    kable0()

list.map(
  l_ora,
  f(i, j, k) ~ {
    tmp <- print_enrich(
      i, 
      regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional
    )
    if (nrow(tmp) > 1)
  heatmap_enrich_full(
    l_ora[[j]],
    l_dea[[j]],
    regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
    width_text = 100
  ) + labs( title = paste("Cluster", k), y = NULL, x = NULL) +
     theme_custom()
  }
) %>%
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = NULL, align = "hv")
 

omics2excel(
  l_ora, 
  file = file.path(path, "ora.xlsx"), 
  func = function(x) print_enrich(x, method = "ora")
)
```

### GSEA
```{r, eval = FALSE}
var <- "gene_name"

l_deg_ranked <- list.map(
    l_dea_proc,
    f(x) ~ {
        metric <- "log2FoldChange"
        de_genes_ranked <- top_genes(x, 0.01, 1, n = Inf) %>% #, rank = TRUE) %>%
            # mutate(ranked_padj = sign(log2FoldChange) * (log10(padj))) %>%
            pull(metric, name = var) %>%
            sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
            .[!is.na(names(.))] %>%
            .[is.finite(.)] %>%
            .[!duplicated(.)]
    }
)

l_gsea <- list.map(
    l_deg_ranked,
    f(x) ~ {
        gseGO(
            x,
            ont = "ALL",
            OrgDb = get(org_lib),
            keyType = "ALIAS",
            verbose = FALSE
        ) %>%
            # setReadable(org_lib, 'ENSEMBL') %>%
            suppressWarnings() %>%
            invisible()
    }
)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
list.map(
    l_gsea,
    f(x, y, z) ~ {
      plot_enrich(
        x,
        cex = 0.65,
        label_x = "NES",
        method = "gsea",
        # regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
        n = 15,
        title = z
      )
    }
) %>%
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

list.map(l_gsea, f(i) ~print_enrich(i, method = "gsea") %>% nrow()) %>%
    list.cbind() %>%
    set_rownames("# Pathway GO") %>%
    kable0()

omics2excel(
  l_gsea, 
  file = file.path(path, "gsea.xlsx"), 
  func = function(x) print_enrich(x, method = "gsea")
)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
list.map(
    l_gsea,
    f(i, j, k) ~ {
        tmp <- print_enrich(
            i,
            method = "gsea",
            regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional
        )
        if (nrow(tmp) > 1)
            heatmap_enrich_full(
                l_gsea[[j]],
                l_dea[[j]],
                method = "gsea",
                regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
                width_text = 100
            ) + labs( title = paste("Cluster", k), y = NULL, x = NULL) +
            theme_custom()
    }
)  %>%
    compact() %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = NULL, align = "hv")
```

## Dotplots
```{r}
l_dea <- list.map(
    unique(l_dea_raw$cluster),
    f(x) ~ filter(l_dea_raw, cluster == x) %>%
    filter(pct.1 > pct_threshold) %>%
  # filter((pct.1 > pct_threshold | pct.2 > pct_threshold) & abs(pct.1 - pct.2) > pct_threshold) %>%
    filter(exp.1 > exp_threshold) %>%
      top_genes(return_rank = TRUE, fc_threshold = fc_threshold, p_threshold = p_threshold)
    ) %>%
    discard(~ nrow(.x) == 0)
```

```{r}
n_tops <- c(10, 15, 50)
tops <- list.map(
  n_tops,
    f(i) ~
    list.map(
    l_dea, 
    f(x) ~ x %>%
      # filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
    slice_head(n = i)
  ) 
) %>% set_names(n_tops)
top10 <- tops[["10"]] %>%
    list.rbind()
```


```{r, eval = FALSE}
last_row_numbers <- top10 %>%
    # ungroup() %>%
    filter(!duplicated(gene)) %>%
    mutate(row_num = row_number() %>% rev()) %>%
    # mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>% # if pseudo
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    pull(row_num) %>%
    sort()

DoHeatmap(
    seurat,
    features = top10$gene,
    # group.by = "cell_type_na",
    group.colors = palette_discrete(),
    slot = "data"
) + 
    NoLegend() + 
    scale_fill_gradientn(
        colors = brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"),
        na.value = "black"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = last_row_numbers[-1] - 0.5, color = "black", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1)
```

```{r}
last_row_numbers <- top10 %>%
    # ungroup() %>%
    filter(!duplicated(gene)) %>%
    mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    pull(row_num) %>%
    sort()

plot_dot(
    seurat, 
    features = unique(pull(top10, "gene"))
) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = last_row_numbers + 0.5)

cluster_marker_genes %>% 
    filter(cluster == 0) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  mutate(padj = format(padj, digits = 1, scientific = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(FC = 2^abs(log2FoldChange) * sign(log2FoldChange)) %>%
   set_rownames(pull(., gene)) %>%
  select(FC, padj) %>%
  kable0()
```

```{r}
top50 <- tops[["50"]] %>%
  list.rbind()
p <- top50 %>%
  pull(cluster) %>%
  unique() %>%
  list.map(
  f(x) ~ plot_dot(
    seurat,
    features = filter(top50, cluster == x) %>% pull("gene") %>% unique()
  ) +
    labs(title = x)
)
```
